timeline.author: Jan Kuipers

timeline.body:
Empirically, there's a trend change 977,450 / 1,000,000 (p=0.997450).

That's means `prob(tp > 90) =~ 0.99991` (if I got my math correct), meaning this test will fail once in every 10,000 runs. That's too often and occasionally fails the CI pipeline.

Reducing the limit to 80 should make it practically never fail.
LGTM. (I think mainly this will be to catch obvious big regressions so we don't need to worry too much about testing statistical power.)
